title.narrative: KILWA CLIMATE RESILIENCE ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINABLE LIVELIHOODS AND BIODIVERSITY

description.narrative: Kilwa Climate Resilience Actions for Sustainable Livelihoods and Biodiversity (KICARE) is a climate resilience project implemented by Mazingira ni Uhai (MNU) in Kilwa District, Tanzania, with funding support from Vi Agroforestry. The project promotes agroforestry, sustainable livelihoods, biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, improved nutrition, and environmental restoration among smallholder farmers, fisherfolk and youth.
